attackers_goals: Attackers may inject code into processes to evade process-based defenses, as well as possibly elevate privileges.
description: An attacker may be trying to avoid detection by injecting their malicious code into a legitimate Windows system binary.
investigative_actions: Check whether the injecting process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Unsigned process injecting into a Windows system binary with no command line
